data.name: CarboVerte
data.description: CarboVerte GmbH is a trading company of biochar-based products located in Eibenstock, Germany, focused on the agricultural and livestock industry as well as urban green spaces. Founded in 2015, the company is registered at the Chemnitz court under HRB 29664, and its corporate purpose is the processing of and trade in biochar and biomass. It operates primarily as a retail/agricultural biochar business via its own webshop and partners, and is not currently listed on major CDR credit registries.
